name: Torre de Cristal

rights.note: Pelli Clarke Pelli, 2004–2008, with Íñigo Ortiz and Enrique León (Ortiz y León Arquitectos). Rooftop garden by Balmori Associates, plant wall by Patrick Blanc.

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q953610_torre_de_cristal.py, tools/meshkit.py) with AI assistance. Geometry from the OpenStreetMap building:parts (made symmetric within 8 cm): a 32.5 × 49.5 m rectangle whose four corners are cut, from 12 m up, by sloping triangular facets that end in a pointed hexagon under one sloping top plane (249 m over the east point, 220 m over the west one). Flat glass faces with thin floor lines (46 office floors) and vertical mullions on the four vertical faces, a lighter crown above 208 m for the greenhouse with the garden, a dark sloping roof. The glass hall round the foot follows the OSM roofs (22 m against the tower on three sides, 12 m on the east, 4 m at the edge) and the east entrance pavilion. Main façade (+Z) = east, where the entrance pavilion is; the west side faces the Paseo de la Castellana. Uncertain: the sloping top (Arquitectura Viva speaks of a two-pitch roof over the greenhouse; OSM maps one plane), the exact height where the lighter crown glass starts, and the hall roofs.
